selectedSpans.quote: The first record is local, and all local records are retained. The clerk concludes that the first record carries catalog code 7.
A separate inventory note says that this record carries catalog code 7.

have _hRetained := localRetention nearby retained hNearby hRule
  exact inventoryRecordCode codeSeven hIndependent

explanation: The local/retention facts do not imply catalog code 7. In the source, the code claim is independently asserted by the inventory note, so the endpoint is supported if that note is accepted. The Lean result likewise proves the endpoint from hIndependent and does not use the retention derivation; its nearby/retained propositions are not linked to codeSeven.

interpretations.meaning: The inference from local status plus retention to catalog code 7 is unsupported; those predicates have no stated bridge to a catalog-code predicate.
interpretations.qualification: The independently stated inventory note supplies the endpoint directly.

interpretations.meaning: The Lean theorem result has endpoint codeSeven.
interpretations.qualification: The localRetention proof is computed into an unused local; it is irrelevant to the returned proof.

evidence.detail: Source prose attributes code 7 to the separate inventory note; no proof or reliability criterion for that note is supplied.
